messages.subject: 🎧 New WSN Podcast Episode Drops Monday: AI in Practice from the Operator’s Seat
messages.text_excerpt:
http://womenssearchnetwork.com

Coming Monday: AI in Practice, Lessons from the Operators Seat

https://womenssearchnetwork.com

🎧 Tune in Monday for a New WSN Podcast Episode 🎧

How can operators turn AI from a buzzword into a competitive advantage? Join Siri Chakka (http://linkedin.com/in/sirichakka/?skipRedirect=true) and Silva Gentchev (https://www.linkedin.com/in/silvagentchev/) as they share how they’re using AI to improve decision making and run their business more effectively. They discuss the tools they use most, what they’ve learned through implementation, and where they see the biggest opportunities for operators today.

Join us on WhatsApp to Chat & Connect (https://womenssearchnetwork.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d304b1b4d9d47429e56f0b05b&id=dd3883dd55&e=eb37beb431) with other Searchers*!

*The community is open to everyone! Please note that the Active Searcher and CEO groups are by request only as they are geared towards serving Active Searchers and CEOs specifically. If you are an Active Searcher or CEO, please make sure your WhatsApp profile has your full name, and that your status is updated with the WSN so your request to join is readily accepted!
